orientation: front hemisphere toward -Y, open rear at center Y, annular rim only; no closing disk

meshing.note: Triangles inscribe the analytic spherical surfaces. Closed cup solid encloses the shell material, not a closed eyeball globe.

texture_bake.method: Orthographic -Y view of original iris/highlight material only, depth-tested original triangles, barycentric original PMX UV lookup, over pure white sclera. Result attached to actual spherical exterior by planar XZ UV coordinates. No original eye triangle is a visible output object.
texture_bake.includes: Original iris, pupil and white highlight pieces in one surface texture; no separate highlight card/mesh.
texture_bake.not_included: Original sclera/upper-shadow geometry; physical/scene lighting supplies shading.

limitations: Original stylized iris/highlights are projected into spherical surface coordinates; oblique views correctly foreshorten with the sphere.
Texture is an offline bake of source colors, not the official game shader.

fit_adjustment.purpose: Fill actual ±34.4-degree eye windows; head remains untouched. Potential hidden socket overlap requires final render review.
